audience: marketing teams that manage branded short links on their own domains with Short.io

useCases.title: Find where a short link points
useCases.text: List the custom domains of the account. Find a short link by its domain and path to see its destination.

useCases.title: Browse the links of a domain
useCases.text: List the short links of one domain, page by page. Open one link to read its original URL, title and tags.

useCases.title: Create a short link for a campaign
useCases.text: List the domains, then create a short link on one of them with a path you choose. An existing path with another URL is refused.

useCases.title: Change where a short link sends visitors
useCases.text: Find the link by its path. Change its destination URL, and the short link sends visitors to the new URL.

useCases.title: Archive links you no longer use
useCases.text: Archive a link to hide it from the dashboard. An archived link still redirects. Unarchive it to show it again.
